Settings.Providers.Heading: Providers
Settings.Providers.Description: Add, reconnect or remove your cloud accounts on the Providers screen.
Settings.Synchronisation.Heading: Synchronisation
Settings.Synchronisation.Description: Choose which remote folders are synchronised and where they are stored on this computer.
Settings.ScopeManagement.Heading: Manage synchronised folders (placeholder)
Settings.ScopeManagement.Consequences: Adding a folder makes its contents part of your synchronisation. Removing a folder stops it being synchronised.
Settings.ScopeManagement.WhatHappensNext: A guided review of the change will be added here. Until then, ticking or unticking a folder above applies at once.
Settings.SyncRoot.Heading: Change the sync folder (placeholder)
Settings.SyncRoot.Consequences: The sync folder is where your synchronised files are stored on this computer. Changing it affects every synchronised file.
Settings.SyncRoot.WhatHappensNext: A guided change with validation and safety checks will be added here. Until then the sync folder cannot be changed once the sync job exists.
